text:
Ravi: Alert storm at 02:15 UTC — cache-miss-rate fired repeatedly, 3 pages in 9m. Opening follow-up thread. incident: https://incidents.redwood/15021
Elena: I saw it. pattern looks like post-deploy jitter. dedupe didn't collapse those pages.
Jo: paste rule?
Ravi: rule snippet:
```
alert: cache_miss_rate_high
expr: sum(increase(cache_miss_total[1m])) by (pool) > 30
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/cache
```
Marta: two quick changes: increase eval window to 3m and add an instance-level dedupe label. also consider a short suppression window for repeated identical alerts.
Jo: agree. also propose changing "for" to 2m to avoid flapping pages from short blips.
Elena: I can take the PR to adjust rule + add unit tests. ETA today EOD.
Ravi: assign Elena owner for rule change, Jo reviewer, Marta to update runbook with paging policy tweaks. timeline: PR today, staging test overnight, rollout tomorrow morning if green.
OpsBot: incident summary: cache_miss_rate_high triggered 2026-06-12T02:15:08Z -> pages:3, resolved 2026-06-12T02:24:20Z, link: https://incidents.redwood/15021
Elena: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/811 — changes: eval window 3m, for:2m, dedupe labels include instance_id, suppression: collapse >2 identical within 10m. CI green. PTAL @Jo @Ravi
Jo: LGTM with one naming nit. will review formally in 2h.
Ravi: Add telemetry ticket to measure "pages reduced by suppression" so we can quantify impact. I'll file it and tag @Marta.
Marta: Filed https://issues.redwood/ops/4302 — ETA next sprint. I'll draft paging wording: if alert resolves <8m -> ticket, >=8m -> page; exceptions for known deploy windows.
Jo: Merged. Rolling to staging now.
Elena: Staging 3h looks stable. Scheduling prod rollout 09:00 UTC.
Ravi: Prod at 100% 09:12, no new pages. Good first pass. We'll reconvene in 7 days to check telemetry. :white_check_mark:
